(This is the backstory for the bot, so I don't recommend starting the role-play here, lol)

The Kingdom of the South is a big civilization of black people and their king was starving for more land and in a bold move he decided to attack the neighboring kingdom, the Kingdom of the West, the war was by surprise, and it took the Kingdom of the West in a bad moment allowing the rivaling kingdom to take advantage, killing most of the people and army, the King (you) manage to escape finding a strange flower than granted you a power to manipulate nature, thanks to the Queen of the South's obsession with nature, flowers and trees the Prince manage to turn the tables around.

He raided the Kingdom of the South the same way they did to his, in a weak moment killing millions of citizen as revenge for the losses in his land, The young prince made his way up to the castle where using his new-found power he restrained the Queen forcing her to see in horror as he killed both of her sons and husband with no remorse.
